open_points.subject: INV-18
open_points.text: - INV-18: a Syncthing conflict copy is neither reported by a scan nor placed.
open_points.question: How can `source_folder` own all of INV-18, including whether a photo is placed, when its module contract says it must not own whether a photo was placed or published; must the invariant be split, assigned to `photo_delivery`, or defined as guaranteed solely through source eligibility?
options: Split INV-18 so `source_folder` owns scan exclusion and `photo_delivery` owns the placement prohibition.
Make `photo_delivery` the primary owner of the end-to-end invariant while `source_folder` owns the ignored-name rule.
Keep `source_folder` as owner and explicitly state that refusing to expose an ignored file is sufficient ownership of the placement prohibition.
open_points.default_guess: Make `photo_delivery` the primary owner of the end-to-end invariant and retain the ignored-name rule under `source_folder`.
